# Copied engine sources that nothing needs, removed by scripts/vendor/strip-engine.sh.
#
# One repository-relative path per line. Each entry is here because a trial build
# showed nothing references it once the excluded subsystems are gone, and because a
# person then agreed. Run strip-engine.sh --report for candidates; do not paste the
# report in wholesale, since a file reached only through a macro or only on another
# platform looks unused to it.
#
# engine/src/arena.c: a stale earlier copy of the arena. Its header already forwards
# to the foundation's arena, whose comment records that the two used to disagree
# silently; the source remained and defined six of the foundation arena's symbols a
# second time, which fails to link as soon as a program needs both objects.
engine/src/arena.c
#
# The four below are what the interface cannot reach: a program referring to every
# function the interface declares, linked against the archive, pulls in every other
# object but these (the link map is the evidence; the build test keeps it true).
#
# engine/src/ac.c, ac.h: a multi-pattern string matcher used only by subsystems that
# are not vendored.
engine/src/ac.c
engine/src/ac.h
# engine/src/foundation/mem.c: the process-wide allocator setup, used only by the
# indexing program the reference ships, not by the engine. Its header stays: the
# memory core includes it.
engine/src/foundation/mem.c
# engine/src/foundation/str_intern.c, str_intern.h: a string interner nothing calls.
engine/src/foundation/str_intern.c
engine/src/foundation/str_intern.h
# engine/vendored/mimalloc/src: the allocator's implementation, reached only from the
# allocator setup above. Its public header stays, with its licence: sources that are
# kept include it for types, behind switches this build leaves off (on Windows, once
# engine/patches/0005 puts the thread source's one unguarded use behind them too).
engine/vendored/mimalloc/src
#
# Found at P1-04, once the stripping above had removed the last callers: files the
# interface still reaches none of.
#
# Headers of subsystems the copy step already leaves out (the stores that spill or
# compress results, the XML export). Nothing includes any of them. (A list of
# approved recursion for parsers that are not vendored was also found unincluded;
# it is no longer copied at all.)
engine/src/iris_export_xml.h
engine/src/lz4_store.h
engine/src/sqlite_writer.h
engine/src/zstd_store.h
# Libraries nothing uses. Compression was reached only through a helper of the
# stripped allocator setup's era, which the interface no longer defines; the other
# two were never included by a kept source.
engine/vendored/lz4
engine/vendored/zstd
engine/vendored/wyhash
